preconditions.description: The number of vertices N is always greater than 1.

preconditions.expression: all(len(edge) == 3 and edge[0] < edge[1] and edge[2] > 0 for edge in edgeList)
preconditions.description: Each edge is a list of three integers [start, end, weight] where start < end and weight is a positive integer.

postconditions.expression: return_value == -1 or (return_value >= 0 and all(0 <= u < N and 0 <= v < N for [u, v, _] in edgeList))
postconditions.description: If no path exists from vertex 0 to vertex N-1, return -1; otherwise, return the total weight of the shortest path from vertex 0 to vertex N-1.

postconditions.expression: all(0 <= u < N and 0 <= v < N for [u, v, _] in edgeList)
postconditions.description: The graph is a directed acyclic graph (DAG) with vertices labeled from 0 to N-1, and edges only go from lower to higher vertices (start < end).
